title: BM25 ranking
summary: Score tokenized documents against a query with BM25: the lesson idf, term frequency saturation with k1, length normalization with b, and a ranked list.

mutants.dedup_query: Loops over the set of query terms, so a repeated query term counts only once.
mutants.df_counts_occurrences: Counts every occurrence of the term for n, not the number of documents that contain it.
mutants.idf_without_one: Uses ln((N - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5)) without the 1 +, so idf is negative for common terms.
mutants.no_k1_plus_one: Leaves out the (k1 + 1) factor in the numerator, so every score is too small by that factor.
mutants.no_length_norm: Uses f + k1 as the denominator and ignores the document length.
mutants.ties_high_index: Breaks ties by the higher document index first, not the lower one.
